answer: Escrowed deposit plus a referral graph stops fakes. Each agent locks twice its 30-day earnings for 20 epochs, its referrer published, so many newcomers from one source look like an ocean of clones. A zephyr of checks each epoch lets any cluster trigger a dispute; losing slashes fake and sponsor. Forging 100 identities costs 2000 units versus 300 honest rewards, while one honest agent pays once, guards its cipher key, and earns undiluted rewards.
